jobs.title: Head of Applied Science
jobs.description: Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers shop with us across Rohlik.cz , Knuspr.de , Kifli.hu , Gurkerl.at , and Sezamo.ro , choosing from over 20,000 items delivered within hours in 15-minute windows. Behind every order is a continuous stream of automated decisions: how much inventory to buy for each warehouse, how many pickers to schedule on Thursday morning, where in the warehouse a product should sit, and which van carries which bags. Our models make these choices every day across five countries. When a forecast is accurate, shelves stay full and waste is minimized. When a plan is right, warehouses run on exact labor needs and orders arrive precisely in the customer’s chosen window. Get it wrong, and it immediately translates into shrink, overtime, tied-up capital, and missed customer deliveries. Why this role is exciting Direct operational and business impact: Your team’s models directly drive availability, shrink, fulfillment costs, and working capital across all five markets. True ownership with zero friction: We operate automated production pipelines with no committee between your team and deployment—a solid backtest is all you need to ship. Unification of two core capabilities: You will bring Forecasting and Optimization into a single function, building an end-to-end decision-making ecosystem from the ground up. AI-first environment: Our engineers use AI coding agents (Devin, Claude Code) daily, and we expect you to push the boundaries of modern agentic workflows and tooling. Direct executive exposure: Reporting directly to the Group CTO, you will have the mandate and space to shape technical strategy and execution. What you will own and deliver Business outcomes: Own the business results delivered by the forecasting and optimization portfolio, setting targets with cell leads and tracking financial and operational impact in production. Strategic roadmap & prioritization: Define which decisions to automate next across purchasing, fulfillment center planning, workforce scheduling, and commercial optimization (promotions, markdowns, demand shaping). Technical standards & architecture: Set the bar for problem framing, method selection, fast production MVPs, honest evaluation/backtesting against business metrics, and reliability monitoring. Function unification & leadership: Merge Forecasting and Optimization into one high-performing team; set hiring standards, develop ML engineers and applied scientists, and foster an AI-first way of working. Cross-functional partnership: Partner closely with cell leads, operations managers, product owners, and engineering leads to align on business metrics, baselines, and seamless system integration. What we are looking for Track record of impact: 8+ years applying machine learning, forecasting, or operations research to real operational or commercial problems, with clear metrics demonstrating business results. Works backwards from outcomes: A proven habit of defining target metrics first, selecting the simplest effective method, shipping fast MVPs, and iterating in production. Hands-on technical depth: Experience building and shipping production models in time-series/probabilistic forecasting or mathematical optimization (LP, MIP, CP, heuristics, simulation), with enough depth to review models and judge when simple heuristics beat complex models. Technical skills: Fluency in Python and SQL; hands-on experience with production pipelines, monitoring, and backtesting; familiarity with modern forecasting stacks or solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools). Operational fluency: Experience working directly alongside supply chain, warehouse, or logistics operations, including spending time on the floor to understand problems before framing models. Leadership & communication: Proven experience leading technical teams, hiring top talent, developing engineers, and translating complex model mechanics into business trade-offs for executives. jobs.description: Short Description SPREAD builds engineering intelligence for the world's most complex products. Our AI-native platform gives automotive OEMs, defense primes, and industrial manufacturers a single source of product truth so engineering teams can make confident product decisions, fast. We work with companies like Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes, Bosch, and Rheinmetall. Backed by HV Capital, DTCP, La Famiglia, and Salesforce. You'll work hands-on with SPREAD's IT operations: Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and our Mac fleet. You'll need to get a real read on where things stand today, tighten up what's loose, and build the habits and documentation that keep it that way going forward. You own identity, endpoint, and device administration directly, handle end-user support and the full joiner-mover-leaver process, and work closely with InfoSec on the security requirements IT operations needs to meet. Your Mission Administer Entra ID day to day, including accounts, groups, access assignments, and SSO/MFA configuration, cleaning up anything that doesn't look right rather than assuming it's correct. Own the full joiner-mover-leaver lifecycle, including passing through existing accounts to close out anything stale or orphaned. Manage the Mac fleet end to end: enrollment, configuration profiles, patching, and device lifecycle from procurement through secure retirement. Keep an accurate asset inventory of who has what, including warranty and lease status. Run first- and second-line end-user support, triaging and resolving tickets in Jira and building the self-service habits that keep the queue manageable. Administer Microsoft 365 and Exchange: mailboxes, distribution lists, licensing, and SharePoint/Teams permissions. Keep the compliance platform (Vanta) current from the IT side, resolving integration drift and keeping evidence fresh for ISO 27001, SOC 2, and TISAX audits. Your Experience Real hands-on experience administering Entra ID and Microsoft 365, from a prior internship, working-student role, or coursework with genuine lab practice, not classroom theory alone. Comfort troubleshooting everyday end-user issues and owning a ticket queue end to end. Exposure to Mac fleet or MDM management specifically. Basic ISO 27001 or audit-support experience, even as part of a team or through training Comfortable completing a background check and signing a confidentiality agreement, given this role's access to company systems and accounts. Based in Berlin and able to work on-site. German at B2 level or above, and fluent English. Why SPREAD? Take real ownership of IT systems that need real attention, not a shadowing or ticket-queue-only role. Work directly with InfoSec and see how a real ISO 27001/SOC 2/TISAX program operates from the inside. Flexible hours built around your studies. Senior team prioritizing craft and accountability over hierarchy. Berlin office with meals provided 3 times a week. If you take pride in your craft and want to help shape the next chapter of our growth, we'd love to hear from you.</p></div><h3>About The Role</h3> <p>As a Product Manager, you will have sole responsibility over the roadmap of one of our technical products (mapping, marketplace, billing, privacy, etc). We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality. At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues— Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1 —guide everything we do. Then, seamlessly shift gears and crush your to-do list from the comfort of your home base for the rest of the week. It's the perfect harmony of productivity and personal freedom. Want a peek inside? Visit our Careers page ! This position can be fully remote anywhere in the United States. Candidates based in San Francisco, CA Indianapolis, IN or New York, NY offices will be expected to work in the office in a hybrid capacity. This position can be based out of our London, UK office and will be expected to work in the office in a hybrid capacity. Authorization to work in the U.S. / UK is a precondition of employment. jobs.description: Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. You will build models of variant effects on protein function and connect them to genomic, single-cell, perturbation and phenotype data. You will also develop agentic AI workflows that help scientists analyse data, test hypotheses and make decisions.</p> <p>This is a hands-on role on a cross-functional team. You will write clear, tested code, use modern AI tools to work faster, and work closely with the computational scientists, experimental biologists, engineers and target discovery leads who act on your results. jobs.description: About Wordsmith Wordsmith is building the legal operating system for in-house teams, and we're growing fast. In-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems. Wordsmith brings that work into one place: requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgement matters, and every step is captured as work happens. We're built for in-house legal, not law firms. More than 500 companies use Wordsmith, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling and Sage. We're backed by over $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others. The role We're hiring an Enablement Lead to own how customers learn Wordsmith, and how they become confident, self-sufficient users of it. You'll own onboarding, training and enablement end to end: Legal AI fundamentals, product and feature overviews, self-paced certifications, and re-enablement for customers who've stalled. You'll teach both ends of the customer organisation: the lawyers and business users in Wordsmith every day, and the champions and admins who support their colleagues. This is an enablement role, not a delivery or commercial one. You won't own implementation, technical support, renewals, account growth or a sales quota. Your focus is capability: do customers know how to use Wordsmith well, and can they keep learning without us? What you'll do Own customer onboarding. Design and run the journey that takes a newly implemented customer to a confident, capable team, and keep improving it. Teach Legal AI fundamentals. Build the curriculum that helps legal teams understand what AI agents do well, where judgement stays with them, and how to work alongside the technology. Run live training. Lead onboarding sessions, product walkthroughs and feature deep dives for lawyers, business users and admins of every technical confidence level. Build the self-paced academy. Create online certifications and learning paths so customers can train new joiners and refresh skills on their own. Maintain the enablement library. Keep guides and product overviews accurate as Wordsmith ships, and retire what's out of date. Re-enable struggling customers. Diagnose why adoption has stalled and run focused programmes that get teams back to self-sufficiency. Train the champions. Equip customer champions and admins to teach their own colleagues, so capability compounds inside each account. Shape in-app help. Work with Product to build guidance, walkthroughs and prompts into Wordsmith itself. Measure whether learning worked. Define what a trained, self-sufficient customer looks like, track it, and use the evidence to change what we teach. Partner across customer teams. Work with Transformation, Customer Success, Support Engineering and Product so enablement reflects real implementations, questions and product changes. What we're looking for 3–5 years in customer enablement, training, onboarding, customer education, implementation or a similar customer-facing role where teaching was central. You design learning, not just deliver it. You can turn a complex product into a curriculum with a clear sequence and outcomes. Confidence in front of a room, in person and on video, with senior lawyers as readily as with day-to-day users. Experience building self-paced content (courses, certifications, guides, video) and a view on what makes people finish it. A clear, warm communication style that makes unfamiliar ideas easy to grasp without oversimplifying them. Strong organisation: you can run several programmes, sessions and content deadlines at once without losing detail. Comfort with data. You can read product-usage information, spot where learning hasn't landed and act on it. Curiosity about AI and legal technology. AI is moving from experimentation into production, and this role is an opportunity to break into AI while doing meaningful enterprise selling.</p> <p>As an Account Executive, AI Hunter, your job is simple: create new SingleStore customers. You will find companies building AI applications where data access, real-time context, memory, retrieval, or operational scale is becoming a constraint—and turn those challenges into new SingleStore customers. You will own a broad territory, build a majority self-sourced pipeline, create demand in an emerging category, and close greenfield enterprise opportunities.</p> <p>This is a true hunting role. You will engage customers before they have a defined project, develop customer-specific points of view, create urgency around business and technical problems, work with technical experts to land first production workloads, and build a measurable new-logo business with broad ownership. The ideal candidate is a measurable enterprise hunter who is competitive, curious, technically credible, resilient, and able to sell business outcomes. Direct AI sales experience is valuable, but proven selling ability and technical curiosity matter more than a narrow “AI seller” title.</p> <h2>Role and Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Build and execute a territory strategy for net-new customer acquisition.</li> <li>Prospect fearlessly across a broad account universe using proactive, persistent outbound, account-based, partner, and market-education motions; own the stakeholder plan, mutual action plan, close plan, value case, stage gates, forecast, and commercial outcome.</li> <li>Lead complex sales cycles through technical validation, security, legal, procurement, negotiation, and close.</li> <li>Partner with Solutions and Forward Deployment Engineers and cross-functional teams to validate technical fit and establish the first production workload.</li> <li>Navigate competitive displacement and maintain disciplined activity management, CRM hygiene, reporting, qualification, forecasting, and opportunity management; showcase clear metrics such as pipeline created, meetings, conversion, quota attainment, and new-logo performance.</li> <li>Be AI fluent: use AI and research tools productively and responsibly while applying judgment, validating outputs, and separating facts from hypotheses.</li> <li>Travel within the assigned territory as required.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2>Required Skills and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of quota-carrying B2B enterprise software sales experience, ideally selling to large or technically sophisticated organizations; experience in data, cloud, analytics, AI, or adjacent technical domains is a plus.</li> <li>Repeated, quantified quota success with clear ownership of new-logo wins and self-sourced pipeline.</li> <li>Experience closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving executives, technical evaluators, security, legal, finance, procurement, and partners.</li> <li>Ability to sell measurable business outcomes and build ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.</li> &lt

jobs.description: ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).   L’ENSTA recrute un(e) gestionnaire juridique et/ou financier des contrats de recherche sur un contrat à durée déterminée dans le cadre du renforcement de ses missions d’appui et de suivi de son activité de recherche et de partenariat.   Au sein de la direction générale des services (DGS) , le/la Gestionnaire juridique et/ou financier des contrats de recherche est rattaché/e à la division des affaires juridiques, des achats et des contrats (DAJ/AC) et placé/e sous l’autorité de la Responsable de la DAJ/AC. Vous serez accompagné dans cette mission de comptables ou d’assistants(es) actuellement basés sur les différents sites : Assez classiquement, vous aurez pour responsabilités :  La gestion financière et comptable du Groupe et de ses différents sites, comprenant notamment : les clôtures comptables et financières mensuelles et annuelles, l'établissement des bilans, la prévision, l'élaboration et le suivi de la trésorerie, la fiscalité, l'analyse, la construction et le suivi des budgets, le développement du contrôle de gestion, ainsi que la mise en œuvre de la politique de financement et le contrôle financier.  Les relations avec les partenaires externes : banques, compagnies d'assurance, cabinet d'expertise comptable, commissaires aux comptes, autorités fiscales, etc.  Le pilotage des projets et des transformations : définir une nouvelle organisation du travail, reconstruire votre équipe dans le cadre de départs à la retraite et contribuer au déploiement de nouveaux outils, dans une logique d'optimisation et d'amélioration continue.  La veille juridique.  Le suivi administratif, notamment des services généraux.  Le management d'une équipe, que vous accompagnez au quotidien dans son activité et dans l'appropriation des changements, tout en veillant à préserver un climat de travail positif et bienveillant. Profil recherché : Issu(e) d'une formation supérieure comptabilité ou finance (Bac +4/5 – DCG, DSCG ou équivalent), vous justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience sur un poste similaire, idéalement acquise au sein d'une PMI multisites. Au-delà des compétences techniques inhérentes à la fonction et d'une solide maîtrise de la comptabilité, nous recherchons avant tout une personne force de proposition, capable de coordonner l'activité, de construire l’organisation de demain, ouverte aux nouvelles technologies et à l'innovation, notamment à l'intelligence artificielle (IA), afin de faire évoluer, à terme, les outils et les processus. L'objectif est d'optimiser les tâches, de sécuriser les données et de mettre en place des outils de pilotage ainsi que des indicateurs de performance pertinents, permettant à la Direction de disposer des informations nécessaires à une prise de décision éclairée. Enfin, c'est votre personnalité, votre capacité à fédérer et à accompagner les équipes, à déléguer tout en restant opérationnel(le), votre esprit d'analyse et de synthèse, votre polyvalence et votre rigueur qui guideront notre choix. jobs.title: Secrétaire Général de l’ODG Picpoul de Pinet  (H/F)
jobs.description: Le Syndicat ODG Picpoul de Pinet recrute ! Rejoignez l'une des appellations les plus dynamiques du Languedoc Le Syndicat ODG Picpoul de Pinet rassemble les acteurs d'une appellation reconnue pour son dynamisme, son identité forte et son développement. À un moment clé de son histoire, l'organisation ouvre un nouveau chapitre. Après plusieurs années de structuration et de développement, le Syndicat fait évoluer sa gouvernance afin d'accompagner les défis de demain : préservation du territoire, développement économique de l'appellation, valorisation de son image et défense de ses intérêts. Dans ce contexte, nous recrutons son(sa) futur(e) : Directeur du Syndicat ODG Picpoul de Pinet (H/F) Votre mission Bras droit du Président et interlocuteur privilégié du Bureau, du Conseil d'Administration et des commissions, vous êtes le garant de la mise en œuvre de la stratégie du Syndicat. Vous pilotez l'ensemble des activités de la structure et accompagnez une gouvernance renouvelée en coordonnant les nombreux acteurs de l'appellation. À la fois stratège et opérationnel, vous assurez le bon fonctionnement quotidien du Syndicat tout en portant les grands dossiers et contribuez aux évolutions stratégiques de l’appellation et accompagnez les projets collectifs des professionnels. Vos principales responsabilités Vous intervenez notamment sur les volets suivants : Piloter le fonctionnement administratif, financier et RH du Syndicat. Préparer, animer et assurer le suivi des instances de gouvernance. Accompagner les élus dans la mise en œuvre de leurs orientations stratégiques. Représenter le Syndicat auprès des partenaires institutionnels et professionnels (INAO, CIVL, collectivités, FranceAgriMer, etc.). Porter les dossiers stratégiques de l'appellation : révision de l'aire, protection de l'AOP, enjeux fonciers, irrigation, infrastructures, développement territorial... Monter et piloter les dossiers de financement et de subventions. Superviser la stratégie de communication et contribuer au rayonnement de l'appellation. Développer la cohésion entre les adhérents et fédérer les différents acteurs autour des projets collectifs. Le profil que nous recherchons Vous possédez une première expérience réussie dans des fonctions de direction, de pilotage de structure ou de conduite de projets complexes. Vous savez évoluer dans des environnements où les dimensions techniques, économiques, institutionnelles et humaines sont étroitement liées. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour : Votre leadership et votre capacité à fédérer ; Votre aisance relationnelle auprès d'interlocuteurs de haut niveau ; Vos excellentes qualités rédactionnelles ; Votre sens de l'organisation et votre capacité à gérer plusieurs dossiers simultanément ; Votre aptitude à convaincre, négocier et représenter une organisation. Vous appréciez les environnements où les décisions se construisent collectivement et savez faire preuve de diplomatie, de discernement et de pragmatisme. Une connaissance du secteur viticole, des filières agricoles ou des organisations professionnelles constitue un véritable atout, sans être indispensable. Nous recherchons avant tout un directeur capable de piloter, coordonner et faire aboutir des projets. Pourquoi rejoindre le Syndicat Picpoul de Pinet ? Vous rejoignez une appellation reconnue, disposant d'une forte notoriété et engagée dans des projets structurants pour son avenir. Ce poste offre une réelle autonomie, une grande diversité de sujets et la possibilité d'avoir un impact concret sur le développement d'un territoire viticole emblématique. Conditions CDI Poste à pourvoir au 1er Octobre Anglais professionel apprécié dans le cadre des actions de valorisation de l’appellation. Poste basé à Pinet (34) Déplacements réguliers en Occitanie et ponctuellement au niveau national Rémunération 40/45 K€ Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

About Sereact Sereact is a Series B embodied-AI company. Cortex, our VLA model, is deployed in live warehouse robotic cells across the EU and US. Zurich is our newest research hub, focused on the manipulation and control problems that sit underneath Cortex. The role This is a Research Engineer position. jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
jobs.description: Description Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes. You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind. Your mission 1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution. Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy. Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters. Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo. 2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer. Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders). Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice. Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos. 3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation. Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations. Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder. What We Want to Achieve Together In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds. In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount. Your profile Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies. Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences. Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility. Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data. AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new. A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough. Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both. Why us? R

jobs.description: Description Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale. We set the standard for AI-powered contract work by offering a platform that changes how legal teams work, from drafting through negotiation to completion. We are now looking for the person who turns what customers actually need into what our AI actually does. Joining Legartis is not taking a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and lawyers, who do not chase hype; we build substance. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place. Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published. Your mission Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you. 1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. And you write the spec, edge cases, and acceptance criteria that Engineering can build against. 2. You build the skills yourself. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on. 3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not. 4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough. Your profile The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant : a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. A legal quant builds with it. They look at a workflow and ask how to redesign it from first principles to get the best possible outcome, rather than making the existing process incrementally faster. A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. Connect research to the decisions that matter most: activation, adoption, retention, and helping new users find their way into n8n with confidence. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Data serving)
jobs.description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. Please note: applications will be open until Tuesday 13th October 2026 at 08.00 CEST. We will not review any application before the closing date so please use this time to submit a high quality application. About the role We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Serving team that owns the production-grade boundary between Pleo's raw product data and everyone who consumes it, including internal product teams, AI agents, and customers directly accessing their own data. This Senior Backend Engineer role builds and owns that boundary: APIs and the low-latency serving layer underneath it. You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source. Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You will report to our Senior Manager of Data & AI Products, and work closely with our Staff Data Platform Engineer, Data Engineers, Product Managers and others Engineers across the business. You'll also coordinate closely with the GenAI Platform and Data Infrastructure teams. What you’ll be doing As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will: Build and own the Data API boundary: delivering clean, versioned, and performant endpoints for internal dashboards, customer-facing features, and third-party tools (e.g., Fivetran connectors via incremental syncs and cursor pagination). Design and optimise the read models, indexes, and caching strategies in Postgres (and future OLAP stores) to guarantee low-latency query performance. Build reliable integrations with Pleo’s Kotlin-based product backend services to ensure the serving layer surfaces the correct data required for a customer facing feature. Own the reliability and performance of the services you build: monitoring, incident response, and SLOs appropriate to customer-facing infrastructure. Partner with Data Engineers to define clean contracts between the ingestion/aggregation layer and the serving DB, ensuring read patterns match storage schemas. Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols. Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services. Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy. Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails. To put things into context, you can expect to work with the following tech stack: AWS (product side), GCP (data side), Docker, Kubernetes, BigQuery, PostgreSQL dbt, Kafka, Airflow, Python, Kotlin and more! What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: Strong backend

Track Companies House filing deadlines, audit exemptions and accounting reference date changes so no entity falls overdue. Payroll and Benefits Oversee monthly payroll and payslip queries with our external accountants Calculation and oversight of variable commission to the sales team Manage share scheme compliance, including EMI notifications and annual returns. Run employee expenses through Xero Expenses and keep the VAT treatment correct so input VAT is reclaimed. Payments, cash and reconciliations Run weekly payment runs, including customer refunds and supplier payments Reconcile bank, Stripe and CRM data; resolve unmatched receipts Raise invoices to developers and customers, track and pay corresponding invoices to partners and agents. Oversee landlord rent collection and payouts for our L&M arm, including statements and discrepancy resolution. Manage credit control, including uncollectible invoices and failed subscription payments. Revenue and commercial controls Reconcile deal revenue, agent fees and customer incentives in HubSpot against finance records. Own subscription billing policy in Stripe, including the approval process for discounts and fee waivers. Run spend analysis across vendors and flag cost trends Systems, process and special projects Automate and document manual finance workflows (Slack, Google Sheets, Zapier, Count) Write and maintain finance guidance for the wider team, such as expenses and subscription policies. Financial Tool You’ll Use: Xero Joiin Stripe HubSpot Count.io Google Sheets, Notion, and automation tools such as Zapier. About You CA, ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualified (or qualified by experience), with 3+ years in finance, ideally including time in practice. Solid UK GAAP (FRS 102) knowledge, including consolidation and intercompany. Strong Excel skills: building clean, formula-driven reconciliations and models others can follow. Confident working with large datasets from multiple sources (bank exports, Stripe, CRM): cleaning and joining them, spotting patterns and anomalies, and turning them into clear insights. Clear, concise communication with non-finance colleagues, and comfort working in a fast-moving startup. A process-improvement mindset. you question how things are done, document what you build, and use AI and automation to make finance work faster and more accurate. Why Join Us? Real scope - you’ll sit close to leadership, your work directly supports the company’s growth Build, don't just maintain. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data. At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day. As a Customer Care Associate – Enterprise , you’ll be dedicated to one of our strategic enterprise accounts and play a critical role in delivering an exceptional customer experience. You’ll own the customer experience from the first point of contact, collaborating with the teams across implementation, customer success, and solutions engineering to drive resolution and ensure consistent delivery at enterprise scale. This role combines day-to-day customer support with continuous improvement. You’ll develop a strong understanding of the customer experience, identify patterns and areas of friction, and help shape how we support Choco’s key customers at scale. jobs.title: AI software Engineer - Project Tricorder
jobs.description: Project Tricorder — Clinical Infrastructure for Field Operations We're looking for a hands-on engineer to build two foundations of the Tricorder product: the evaluation harness and training data pipeline behind our AI models, and a clinical knowledge base grounded in tactical combat care, SNOMED CT and ICD-10. About Project Tricorder - https://www.tricorder-systems.com/ Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity and a clinician at a desk. Care increasingly happens somewhere else - in the field, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient reaches a ward. Tricorder builds the deployable clinical infrastructure for that world: a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform that lets clinical teams capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when the network or the grid can't be relied on. It is a dual-use venture serving defence medical and civilian pre-hospital care. Our prototype product is already in user testing. Edge AI sits at the core: multimodal language models that turn video, sensor data and clinical notes into patient records, drive predictions and inform data-driven learnings across deployments. To trust those models in the field, we need rigorous data and evaluation - that's where you come in. What you'll do You'll own two workstreams, working day to day with the founder and the FF build team. 1. Data pipeline and evaluation harness Build the data foundations that tell us whether our models are good enough for clinical use. Data labelling: design labelling schemas and guidelines, set up tooling, and run labelling with clinical input, including quality checks and inter-annotator agreement. Data processing: build reproducible pipelines to ingest, clean, de-identify and transform multimodal data (video, sensor streams, text). Video data organisation: structure, version and catalogue video datasets so clips, annotations and metadata stay searchable and traceable. Training dataset preparation: assemble balanced, well-documented train, validation and test splits, with clear lineage from raw data to model input. Eval harness: build an automated harness that benchmarks vision-language and NLP models against clinically meaningful metrics, tracks regressions and supports build-vs-buy model decisions. 2. Clinical knowledge base Build the structured clinical knowledge base that turns unstructured input into coded, interoperable records. Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders , and pushing back on ill-defined asks. Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour. jobs.title: Infrastructure Software Engineer
jobs.description: Join our mission We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products. We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run. After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective. Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers. Own the software that drives our hardware. You'll write the control planes, automation, and observability that keep our global fleet fast, efficient, and reliable, while charting a path to scale that continues to increase the number of "machines under management" per engineer. Our culture We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. jobs.description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. The Role You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. What You'll Work On Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds. Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains. Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships. jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer - Design for Cost & Product Improvement
jobs.description: As Mechanical Engineer, within Distalmotion’s Instruments – Product Improvement team, you will be responsible for driving product optimization initiatives with a strong emphasis on cost reduction, manufacturing efficiency, and continuous product improvement for the Instruments of the surgical system. The Mechanical Engineer brings solid experience in component and tooling design with associated impact analysis (impact on design verification, risk assessment, quality and manufacturing costs) and root cause investigation of clinical complaints and/or non-conformities. Tasks : Design & Cost Optimization • Specify design, prototype, and implement mechanical components and custom tooling/fixtures with a strong focus on Design for Manufacturing, Assembly and Cost (DFM/DFA/DFC). • Identify, justify and execute cost reduction opportunities on existing instruments without compromising performance, quality or safety. • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders from manufacturing of prototypes to testing and industrialization of the products. Impact analysis • Perform comprehensive impact analysis of the proposed design changes, evaluating effects on manufacturing processes, unit costs, risk management and design verification. • Evaluate financial impact of proposed design changes, including tooling/fixture investments, scrap reduction and cycle time improvement. • Define technical requirements and test protocols and ensure traceability with the design in test reports. Supervise and participate to design verification. • Collaborate with internal teams (Ops, QA, RA). • The compliance with the applicable laws and standards and the design control practices is a must (e.g. ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR 820, MDR). Continuous Improvement • Investigate clinical complaints and production non-conformity. • Lead root cause analysis and manage Corrective and Preventive Actions to drive continuous product quality and reliability improvements. Requirements Education & Experience • Mechanical, microtechnology engineering degree or equivalent (BSc or MSc) • At least 5 years of experience in the medical device industry or highly regulated environment (eg. Aerospace, automotive) Technical competency • Proficiency in CAD (SOLIDWORKS preferred) • Design For Manufacturing experience (plastic and metal injection, stamping, …), for medium to high volume manufacturing • Relevant experience in Design Control (Design input/output/transfer, Risk Analysis, Failure mode analysis) • Knowledge of change management workflows Soft Skills • Strong analytical, problem-solving, pragmatic and creative skills • Good communication skills with proactive attitude and strong accountability under limited supervision • Language: French, English Benefits What we offer : A dynamic, innovative environment with cutting-edge medical technology that is shaping the future of robotic surgery. Fast-growing Company where innovation meets agility. Structured onboarding program and training, ensuring a confident start. High degree of autonomy and flexibility. Die Position des Senior Bid & Project Managers (w/m/d) umfasst die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für die Vorbereitung und Durchführung anspruchsvoller Angebote und Projekte im Bereich Qualified Space Products – von der Anforderungsanalyse und Angebotserstellung über die initiale Projektplanung bis zur erfolgreichen Auslieferung. Der Verantwortungsbereich umfasst Projekte mittlerer bis hoher Komplexität, die durch umfangreiche technische und logistische Anforderungen, die Einbindung verschiedener Organisationseinheiten, Partner und Lieferanten sowie anspruchsvolle kommerzielle und rechtliche Rahmenbedingungen gekennzeichnet sind. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die Einhaltung von Meilensteinen, vertraglichen Zielen, Budget, Zeitplan und Qualitätsanforderungen sowie die Sicherstellung einer hohen Kundenzufriedenheit. Aufgaben Bid- & Projektmanagement Verantwortung für die Vorbereitung und Steuerung komplexer Angebote und Projekte – von der Anforderungsanalyse über die Planung bis zur erfolgreichen Auslieferung. Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Budget, Zeitplan, Meilensteinen, Qualität und vertraglichen Zielen. Erstellung und Steuerung der initialen Projektplanung sowie der Initial Project Baseline. Bewertung der technischen, wirtschaftlichen und vertraglichen Machbarkeit von Angeboten und Projekten. Identifikation und aktive Steuerung von Risiken und Chancen sowie kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Projektmanagementmethoden und -prozesse. Kunden- & Stakeholdermanagement Zentrale Schnittstelle für Kunden, interne Fachbereiche, internationale Standorte, Partner und Lieferanten. Aufbau und Pflege nachhaltiger Kunden- und Stakeholderbeziehungen sowie Sicherstellung einer hohen Kundenzufriedenheit. Koordination aller relevanten Projektbeteiligten und Sicherstellung einer effizienten Zusammenarbeit. Durchführung von Verhandlungen innerhalb des erteilten Mandats. Teamführung & Business Development Fachliche Führung und Koordination interdisziplinärer Projektteams sowie Förderung einer konstruktiven und leistungsorientierten Zusammenarbeit. Unterstützung und Coaching von Kolleginnen und Kollegen bei anspruchsvollen Bid- und Projektsituationen. Unterstützung des Vertriebs bei der langfristigen Geschäftsentwicklung, beispielsweise durch Marktanalysen, Kundenanforderungen und Konzeptentwicklung. Übernahme von Koordinationsaufgaben innerhalb des lokalen Bid- und Projektteams in Abstimmung mit dem Head of Bids & Projects. Prozesse & kontinuierliche Verbesserung Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung der Prozesslandschaft Optimierung von Bid- und Projektmanagementprozessen sowie Initiierung von Produkt- und Prozessverbesserungen. Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung moderner Methoden und Standards zur kontinuierlichen Steigerung von Effizienz, Qualität und Projekterfolg. jobs.title: Developer (m/w/d) E-Commerce
jobs.description: Wer sind wir? Active Nutrition International GmbH (ANI) ist ein dynamisches wachstumsorientiertes Unternehmen in der Sporternährungsbranche, das mit seinen drei starken Marken – Powerbar, Dymatize und Premier Protein – weltweit Athleten und Fitnessbegeisterte mit hochwertigen, innovativen Produkten unterstützt. Seit über 30 Jahren prägen wir den Markt für Sportnahrung, insbesondere in Zentral- und Westeuropa und setzen stets neue Maßstäbe in der Branche. 🚴‍♂️ Powerbar : Energiegeladene Produkte für Ausdauersportler 🏋️‍♂️ Dymatize : Proteine und Nahrungsergänzungen für Deine Erfolge im Fitnessstudio 🍫 Premier Protein : Leckere Lean-Protein-Produkte für den Alltag Als Teil von BellRing Brands, einem globalen Player im Bereich der Sporternährung, ist Active Nutrition International mit Sitz in München und eigener Produktionsstätte in Voerde, eine wichtige Tochtergesellschaft für den internationalen Markt. Als Developer (m/w/d) E-Commerce bist du für den Betrieb, die Weiterentwicklung und die Vernetzung unserer digitalen Commerce- und CRM-Landschaft verantwortlich. Gemeinsam mit den Teams aus Marketing, Sales und Customer Service entwickelst du skalierbare digitale Lösungen und treibst die digitale Transformation unseres internationalen E-Commerce-Geschäfts aktiv voran. Aufgaben Deine Rolle bei uns 🚀 Shopify-Landschaft betreiben & weiterentwickeln: Du übernimmst die technische Konfiguration, Administration und kontinuierliche Optimierung unserer internationalen Shopify-Landschaft (Shopify Plus). Dabei setzt du neue Features um, stellst eine hervorragende User Experience sowie eine hohe Performance sicher und identifizierst Standardisierungsmöglichkeiten im internationalen Umfeld. CRM-Architektur aufbauen & steuern: Du entwickelst, konfigurierst und optimierst unsere CRM-Systeme (z. B. Brevo, Klaviyo oder HubSpot), um Customer Journey zu automatisieren, Inhalte zu personalisieren und die Conversion und Konsumentenzufriedenheit nachhaltig zu steigern. Prozess- und Integrationsplattformen betreuen: Du planst, entwickelst und verwaltest Schnittstellen sowie automatisierte Workflows über Integrationsplattformen wie Make.com . So sorgst du für einen reibungslosen Datenaustausch zwischen Shopify, CRM, ERP, Social-Media-Plattformen und weiteren Systemen. Systemarchitektur & Datenflüsse optimieren: Du stellst die Datenintegrität über alle Systeme hinweg sicher und entwickelst unsere Systemlandschaft kontinuierlich weiter. Dabei optimierst du Schnittstellen und Prozesse für eine effiziente und skalierbare digitale Infrastruktur. Zusammenarbeit & Support: Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams aus Marketing, Sales und Customer Service zusammen, um technische Anforderungen in funktionierende digitale Lösungen zu übersetzen und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Systeme aktiv voranzutreiben. Qualifikation Deine Erfahrungen & Skills 💪 Praktische Erfahrungen & Schnittstellenkompetenz: Du verfügst über 4 bis 6 Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position an der Schnittstelle von E-Commerce, Technologie und CRM. Shopify-Expertise: Du bringst ein tiefes technisches Verständnis der Shopify-Plattform mit, einschließlich Konfiguration, Theme-Anpassungen, App-Integrationen sowie der Shopify-API-Landschaft. CRM-Know-how: Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung in der technischen Konfiguration, Datenmodellierung und Automatisierung von CRM-Lösungen Integration & Automation-Skills: Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung und Konfiguration von Integrations- und Automatisierungslösungen, idealerweise mit Tools wie Make.com , sowie in der Anbindung unterschiedlicher API-Schnittstellen. Business-Verständnis : Du besitzt ein gutes kaufmännisches Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse. Erfahrungen in der FMCG-Branche sind von Vorteil Soft skills: Du bringst Eigeninitiative sowie eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe mit und kannst dich schnell in komplexe Problemstellungen einarbeiten Benefits Warum Active Nutrition Internati

Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With 30 offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. jobs.title: Business Development Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Als Business Development Manager (m/w/d) bei Enpal Financial Solutions arbeitest Du an einer zentralen Frage: Wie können wir unser Partnergeschäft erfolgreicher und skalierbarer machen? Du übernimmst ein eigenes Portfolio an Installateur-Partnern und analysierst, wo Wachstumspotenziale liegen, welche Herausforderungen unsere Partner haben und welche Maßnahmen den größten Impact schaffen. Dabei geht es nicht darum, bestehende Prozesse einfach abzuarbeiten. Du strukturierst komplexe Probleme, stellst die richtigen Fragen, entwickelst neue Lösungsansätze und setzt diese hands-on um . Du kombinierst analytisches Denken, Business Development und kommerzielles Verständnis und arbeitest eng mit Sales, Operations und Product zusammen. Deine Ideen sollen nicht nur auf dem Papier funktionieren – Du bringst sie in die Umsetzung und misst ihren tatsächlichen Impact. Dein Spielfeld Business Development & Growth Du analysierst die Entwicklung unserer Partner und identifizierst konkrete Wachstums- und Aktivierungspotenziale. Du untersuchst, warum bestimmte Partner erfolgreicher sind als andere und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen und Best Practices ab. Du entwickelst neue Ansätze, um die Nutzung unserer Finanzierungslösung bei Partnern zu steigern. Du erkennst Chancen frühzeitig und gehst diese proaktiv an. Du denkst über einzelne Partner hinaus und entwickelst Lösungen, die auf größere Teile unseres Partnernetzwerks übertragbar sind. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Umsetzung Deiner Ideen und misst deren Erfolg. Analytics & Problem Solving Du nutzt Daten und KPIs, um komplexe Fragestellungen zu strukturieren und relevante Insights zu gewinnen. Du gehst Problemen auf den Grund und fragst Dich nicht nur „Was passiert?“ , sondern vor allem „Warum passiert es?“ und „Was können wir verändern?“ Du übersetzt Analysen in konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen. Du erkennst Zusammenhänge und Muster und entwickelst daraus neue Lösungsansätze. Du hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und identifizierst Möglichkeiten, unser Partnergeschäft effizienter und skalierbarer zu machen. Du kannst zwischen Detailtiefe und strategischer Perspektive wechseln. Partner & Commercial Ownership Du baust langfristige Beziehungen zu unseren Installateur-Partnern auf und verstehst deren Geschäftsmodelle und Vertriebsprozesse. Du bist Sparringspartner für Deine Partner und hilfst ihnen dabei, konkrete Business-Ziele zu erreichen. Du kannst analytische Erkenntnisse in überzeugende Empfehlungen übersetzen und unterschiedliche Stakeholder für Veränderungen gewinnen. Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit einer Hands-on-Mentalität und bist bereit, selbst in die Umsetzung zu gehen. Zusammenarbeit & Aufbau Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Operations und Product zusammen. Du bringst Deine Erkenntnisse in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse und unseres Partnerangebots ein. Du hilfst dabei, Best Practices und skalierbare Strukturen aufzubauen. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für neue Themen und treibst sie eigenständig von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung. Du wartest nicht darauf, dass für jedes Problem bereits ein Prozess existiert. Das bringst Du mit Du hast erste Berufserfahrung in Business Development, Consulting, Strategy, Sales, Key Account Management, Commercial Operations oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld. Du verfügst über eine ausgeprägte analytische und unternehmerische Denkweise . Du hast Spaß daran, komplexe Probleme zu strukturieren und aus Daten konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten. Du denkst proaktiv, erkennst Chancen und möchtest Dinge selbst voranbringen. Du hast eine Growth-Mentalität und möchtest nicht nur bestehende Prozesse verwalten, sondern neue Lösungen entwickeln. Du hast ein gutes kommerzielles Verständnis und kannst Dich in Kunden- und Partnerperspektiven hineinversetzen. Du fühlst Dich in einem Startup- oder Scaleup-Umfeld wohl und hast Lust, Strukturen mit aufzubauen. Consulting-Erfahrung ist willkommen, aber kein Muss – wichtiger sind Problemlösungskomp

jobs.title: Teamleiter:in für Photovoltaikanlagen (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen. Deine Aufgaben Projektbetreuung : Operative und planerische Unterstützung in der Fertigstellung von Photovoltaikanlagen und Wärmepumpen Führungsaufgaben : Koordinierung diverser Teams, um eine reibungslose und effiziente Installation unserer Produkte sicherzustellen Fachliche Betreuung : Enger Austausch mit den Teams zur Abstimmung von Arbeitsabläufen und erste Ansprechperson bei technischen Herausforderungen vor Ort Kooperation : Enge Zusammenarbeit und regelmäßiger Austausch mit anderen Abteilungen, insbesondere dem Qualitätsmanagement und der Logistik, um gemeinsame Ziele zu erreichen Dein Profil Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Elektroniker (Energie- und Gebäudetechnik wünschenswert) 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung im elektrotechnischen Bereich Idealerweise Erfahrungen im Projektmanagement oder als Bauleitung Exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in deutscher und englischer Sprache Teamfähigkeit sowie eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise Gültiger Fahrerlaubnis der Klasse B Gute Computerkenntnisse und sicherer Umgang mit gängigen MS-Office Anwendungen Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️ Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit. Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten. Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen. Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt. Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt. Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt. Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents. Dein Extra-Boost - 29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heilig Abend & Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden. Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskrimi

jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation. We are seeking a talented Thermal Engineer to help us in our mission by contributing to the development of our future projects. As a Thermal Systems Engineer, you will oversee the thermal architecture, sizing and analysis of a variety of new projects. You will work closely with our mechanical, CAD, and system engineers to assess feasibility and preliminary sizing of the thermal systems of our future vehicles. Key Responsibilities In your capacity as a Thermal Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day your duties will include: Designing conceptual and preliminary thermal control systems for new space systems, tailored to project maturity and goals Providing technical solutions to optimise thermal management, in collaboration with other subsystems (propulsion, avionics, ECLSS…) Perform preliminary thermal analyses to justify the design decisions Effectively communicating and providing recommendations through analyses, reviews, documentation and presentation of technical data Supporting spacecraft development from concept to operations, including feasibility studies, trade-off analyses, requirements review, system design, and documentation for major development milestones Managing procurement, request for proposals, supplier evaluation and selection, testing and validation of thermal hardware Providing operational analysis and support, including post-flight analyses What We Would Love to See from You In the role of Future Project Thermal Engineer ideally, you will have the following: Education : Master’s or PhD degree in Aerospace Engineering, Heat transfer and Fluid mechanics, or another related field. Technical skills: Thermal analysis, Thermal management of typical spacecraft subsystems (structures, avionics, propulsion), and understanding of spacecraft thermal environments Experience: Proven experience (3+ years) with (Active) Thermal Control System development and procurement, hands-on experience with Thermal Testing, including Thermal Cycling, Thermal Vacuum and Thermal Balance tests Programming Skills: Proficiency with thermal software (Thermal Desktop, ESATAN), and in programming and data analysis (e.g., Python, MATLAB, C++). Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Feedback : Willingness to give proactive and mindful feedback across all company levels. Mindset: Passion for advancing sustainability in the space industry and highly motivated to work in a fast paced, autonomously driven, and demanding start-up environment. Languages: Fluent in English. Why you should join us! jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. Location This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region. Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp. Your Mission You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast. As a Senior Project Manager , you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once. At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical. You will not be alone with the technical side. jobs.description: Deine Mission Wir sind ein wachsendes PropTech-Startup aus Münster. Unsere KI-gestützte Software ist die Entscheidungsgrundlage für die Immobilienentwicklung. Projektentwickler, Bestandshalter, Banken und Makler nutzen syte, um in Sekunden zu entscheiden, ob, was und wo gebaut, saniert oder gekauft wird. Ausgezeichnet wurden wir mit dem Deutschen KI-Preis 2023 und dem PropTech of the Year Award 2025 des ZIA (Zentraler Immobilien Ausschuss). Heute bildet unsere Plattform auf Basis von über 300 Terabyte Geodaten digitale Zwillinge für 62 Millionen Gebäude und Grundstücke in Deutschland ab. Für den nächsten Sprung, von unseren heutigen Gebäudemodellen zum texturierten LoD3-Gebäude, suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Senior Computer Vision / Photogrammetry Engineer (m/w/d) in Münster oder deutschlandweit remote . Deine Aufgaben: Alle Quellen in einem Modell vereinen: Du kombinierst 2D-Katasterdaten, LiDAR-Punktwolken, Schrägluftbilder, Nadir-Satellitenbilder und weitere Quellen zur genauestmöglichen Abbildung der realen Welt. So überwindest du begrenzte Bildauflösung und Verdeckungen durch Bäume und andere Objekte. Forschung in die Produktion bringen: Gemeinsam mit unseren Data Engineers, die Pipelines und Plattform verantworten, skalierst du Methoden von einer Handvoll Gebäude auf Millionen. Erfahrung: Mindestens vier Jahre Praxis- oder Forschungserfahrung (z. B. Promotion, wissenschaftliche Mitarbeit) im Bereich (urbane) 3D-Rekonstruktion, Computer Vision und Photogrammetrie, inklusive der Entwicklung funktionierender Produkte oder Prototypen. Photogrammetrie: Fundierte Kenntnisse in Photogrammetrie und Fernerkundung: Sensor- und Kameramodelle, Kalibrierung sowie innere und äußere Orientierung. Praktische Erfahrung darin, Airborne-LiDAR und Luftbilder zu metrisch belastbaren, georeferenzierten Daten zu kombinieren. Praktische Erfahrung darin, aus Punktwolken und Bildern Gebäudemodelle zu erzeugen. Central to the Music Mission's vision is the development of promotional tools for artists and label teams, powered by Spotify's deep knowledge of listener behavior. Products like Discovery Mode, Marquee, Showcase, Music Videos, and Clips help artists and their teams grow their audiences, connect with fans, and achieve their goals on Spotify. We're looking for a Data Scientist to join Discovery Mode within the Music Mission. Discovery Mode is a tool for artists and music marketers designed to help find new listeners when it matters most. With Discovery Mode, artists and labels identify songs that are a priority, and our systems use that signal to inform the algorithms that power personalized recommendations. This role sits within the ML squad that builds and operates the models behind Discovery Mode's measurement system, and you'll serve as the squad's analytical lead. In this role, you'll partner closely with product managers and ML engineers to evaluate and improve the models that power Discovery Mode. You'll tackle complex analytical problems by designing experiments, developing evaluation frameworks, and building the analytical foundations that help keep our models accurate, reliable, and impactful for artists. As part of the Product Insights team within Music Mission, you'll help shape the measurement systems behind one of Spotify's most important promotion products. What You'll Do Own the analytical function for the Discovery Mode ML squad, driving evaluation and continuous improvement of the models that power measurement and campaign optimization Partner with ML engineers to develop evaluation frameworks and identify opportunities to improve model performance, reliability, and customer impact Design and execute rigorous experiments to evaluate model quality, measure outcomes, and guide model development Conduct deep-dive analyses to assess model performance and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for product and business stakeholders Build, maintain, and evolve dashboards that track model health, customer metrics, and program performance Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and cross-functional partners to align analytical priorities with squad goals and customer needs Contribute to the broader Product Insights community by sharing best practices and helping raise the bar for analytics across Discovery Mode Who You Are You have 4+ years of experience in a data science role and a degree in data science, statistics, economics, mathematics, or a related quantitative field You have experience measuring customer outcomes, defining KPIs, and connecting analytical insights to product decisions You know how to design and implement A/B tests, understand when experimentation is the right tool, and interpret results with appropriate rigor You have experience evaluating machine learning model performance and partnering with ML engineers to improve model and customer outcomes You are comfortable working in a highly technical environment and collaborating closely with engineering partners You communicate complex statistical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences You have strong data science fundamentals, including Python, SQL, BigQuery, dbt, data storytelling, and experience working within cross-functional product teams You have experience in areas such as advertising measurement, recommendation systems, experimentation, or causal inference at scale Where You'll Be We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the EST timezone region as long as we have a work location. This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.
